info.reference.style.invalid_colour: `{role}` is set to "{value}", which is neither a hex color (#RGB, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA, in quotes: a bare # starts a YAML comment) nor the name of a color, so the shipped {default} is used instead.
info.reference.style.retired_key: `{role}` is ignored: this color is now derived from its base color, so that text in it is always readable, and has no place in the file.
interpretation.fragment.demography.shift: The age distribution has shifted toward the {dominant_band} group, against a baseline of {baseline_band}.
